article.title: Pentagon puts Musk at the center of its war planning
article.author: Editor
article.content: Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Palmer Luckey’s Anduril do billions of dollars of business with the Pentagon. Now, the Pentagon has given the two billionaires the job of telling it what to buy. The post Pentagon puts Musk at the center of its war planning appeared first on MR Online .
